column1: # The servers this engine's committed answers come from. default records the
# tapes and serves the catalog and review suites; parser judges
# tidb/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same pingcap/tidb:v8.5.5 release so
# a judge revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching the default-pinned
# parser judge revision 2 re-asks 1273 (Unknown collation) from CollationName's
# parse-time lookup using TiDB's built-in 'utf8mb4_bin' stand-in so trailing
# syntax errors are not hidden behind the lookup abort.
